results.title: Nigeria-focused OPay seeks $366 million in New York IPO at $4.4 billion valuation as Standard Bank commits up to $200 million | Business Insider Africa
results.snippet:
OPay has received board approval to pursue a secondary listing on the Nigerian Exchange after completing its New York flotation.

The Nigerian listing remains conditional on market conditions, regulatory approval and compliance with local trading and settlement requirements.
